issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

callLogFilePath.description:
The path to the file where calls will be logged or from which they will be read depending on the value of
the `mockLlmMode` property.
If the mode is 'record', then the file at `callLogFilePath` will be created if it does not exist and will be
appended to otherwise.
NOTE: In order to allow appending, 'record' only supports local (to the server) files in the tmp directory.


If the mode is 'playback', then the file at `callLogFilePath` must exist and have the results of previous
'record' mode runs.
NOTE: During playback, if a call can not be found in the records, the mock LLM will throw an error and saved the unmatched
call at "'/tmp/' + C3.pkg().name() + '/test/resource/mockLlmCallLog/' + filename + 'unmatched_calls.txt'".

mode.description:
The mode of the mock LLM. If set to `off`, the mock LLM will not be used.

If set to `record`, the mock LLM will record all calls to the LLM and write them to the file specified by the
`callLogFilePath` property.

If set to `playback`, the mock LLM will read calls from the file specified by `callLogFilePath` and return
them instead of calling the app-configured LLM.

title: Config to control the behavior of the mock LLM.
